title: The Pink Christmas Reading Corner
description: A pink Christmas reading corner from Walmart: a velvet embroidered snowflake pillow, a fuzzy pink throw, faux fur slippers, a Christmas sweater mug, a Pink Berry Freesia candle and a clip-on book light.
intro: Every December I swear I will read more, and every December I end up scrolling on the couch instead. So this year I built the excuse right into the corner of the living room: a snowflake pillow, the softest pink throw, slippers that live by the chair, a sweater mug for cocoa, a candle that smells like berries and a little book light so I can keep going after everyone is asleep. It is the most-used corner in my house now, and nobody is allowed to sit there but me.

sections.heading: The cozy layer
paragraphs: The Holiday Time velvet embroidered snowflake pillow in pink and white, the Joyfy pink ribbed throw and the Joyspun faux fur X-band slippers in pink.

sections.heading: The little things that make it a ritual
paragraphs: The Holiday Time Christmas sweater mug in pink, red and white, the Better Homes & Gardens Pink Berry Freesia 2-wick candle and the Glocusent clip-on book light in purple.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The armchair, tree, books and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
